messages.text: Team, INC-204 was unacceptable. We had checkout authorization hanging for 45 minutes because Kafka consumer partition rebalance paused replies.
Agreed Marcus. ADR-018 originally prescribed Kafka for RPC back in 2023, but at our current 85,000 req/sec scale, async RPC emulation over message queues creates unbounded tail latencies.
From SRE vantage: when broker rebalance triggers, timeouts cascade to upstream proxies. We must move synchronous inter-service calls directly to gRPC with HTTP/2 and mTLS.
Identity team supports this. We have protobuf specs ready. I will draft ADR-051 to officially deprecate sync Kafka RPC and supersede ADR-018 immediately.
Consensus reached. Let's record ADR-051 and update all service runbooks. Note: Ensure onboarding docs get updated so newcomers stop using Kafka for sync queries!
